Overview

The Securities Market TechSprint 2026 is an innovation challenge being organized by SEBI, in collaboration with leading market infrastructure institutions and industry bodies. It is designed to harness India's technological talent to address real world challenges within the securities market.

The TechSprint invites innovators to design and build cutting edge digital solutions focused on empowering retail investors and bolstering transparency, efficiency, compliance, and accessibility across India's vibrant capital markets.

Participants are challenged to develop solutions addressing one of the key problem statements and showcase their groundbreaking solutions at Global Fintech Fest.

Evaluation Process

  • Round 01: Preliminary shortlisting of the applications.

  • Round 02: Shortlisting of working prototype and demo video.

  • Round 03: Final evaluation.

Evaluation Criteria

  1. Market Impact: Potential to improve investor protection, market efficiency, compliance, or accessibility.

  2. Technology Stack: Effective use of AI, ML, Blockchain, NLP, DPI, and other advanced technologies.

  3. Feasibility: Real world deployability and ease of implementation.

  4. Scalability: Potential to scale scope of operation, number of users, number of transactions, velocity, and more.

  5. Alignment with SEBI's Mandate: Investor protection, market development, and supervision.

Join the SEBI Securities Market TechSprint and help shape the future of investor protection, market development, financial inclusion, and regulatory excellence through technology and innovation.

Prototype Development

In this phase, shortlisted teams are required to build and submit a working prototype that demonstrates their solution to the selected problem statement. The prototype should showcase the core functionality, technical implementation, and real-world applicability of the solution.

Evaluation Criteria

  • Market Impact: Potential to create meaningful value for the securities market.
  • Technology & Innovation: Effective use of relevant technologies and innovative approaches.
  • Feasibility: Practicality and readiness for real-world implementation.
  • Scalability: Ability to support future growth and wider adoption.
  • Alignment with SEBI's Objectives: Relevance to the problem statement and SEBI's mandate.

Demo & Jury Evaluation

Shortlisted teams will present their working prototypes during the Demo & Jury Round (22–25 August 2026). Evaluations will be conducted by experienced professionals and domain experts from SEBI based on the evaluation criteria above.

Submission Tips

  • Demonstrate a functional prototype rather than static designs or mockups.
  • Ensure your deployment and GitHub links are accessible.
  • Keep your demo video focused on the problem, solution, and key features.
  • Be prepared to explain your implementation and key decisions during the jury evaluation.

Final Pitch & Awards

Finalist teams will present their solutions before the Grand Jury during Global Fintech Fest 2026 in Mumbai. The presentation should clearly demonstrate the problem, the solution, its impact, and the overall value it brings to the securities market ecosystem.

The jury will comprise experienced professionals and domain experts from SEBI, who will interact with teams through a Q&A session to better understand the solution, its implementation, and its potential for real-world adoption. Winners will be announced during the closing ceremony at GFF 2026.

Eligibility

  • Startups
  • Students (Undergraduate, Postgraduate, and Doctoral)
  • Individuals including Technology Professionals, Market Researchers, and Innovators
  • Fintech, RegTech, WealthTech, and Capital Markets Solution Teams
  • SEBI officials are not eligible to participate.

Team Requirements

  • Teams can consist of 1 to 5 members.

Rules

  1. Solutions must address one of the official problem statements announced by SEBI.
  2. Teams may participate individually or with up to 5 members.
  3. All submissions must be original and should not infringe on any intellectual property rights.
  4. Participants are encouraged to leverage technologies such as AI, ML, Blockchain, NLP, DPI, and Advanced Analytics.
  5. Teams must submit all required deliverables before the specified deadlines for each round.
  6. Shortlisted teams must participate in the prototype demonstration and jury evaluation rounds.
  7. Solutions should be practical, scalable, and applicable to real world securities market challenges.
  8. Participants must comply with all confidentiality, security, and data privacy requirements.
  9. The decision of the jury and organizing committee will be final and binding.
